description:
Cast Coveted Jewel by paying {0} due to Heliod.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {U}{U} due to Heliod.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for Paradoxical Outcome, if needed, and putting it into your hand.
Cast Paradoxical Outcome by paying {U} due to Heliod, returning Coveted Jewel and Invasion of Arcavios from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
